###### LOAD PACKAGES AND LIBRARIES ######
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Run these ONCE to install, then leave commented out.
# (install.packages re-downloads every run if left active, which is slow.)
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "writexl", "egg",
#                    "stringr", "lubridate", "rgbif", "gbifdb", "sf", "httr2", "readxl"))
# remotes::install_github("duckdb/duckdb")

library(tidyverse)   # data cleaning + ggplot2, dplyr, stringr, etc.
library(writexl)     # write Excel files
library(readxl)      # read Excel files (CABR_specimens_V8.xlsx)
library(egg)         # arranging ggplot figures
library(lubridate)   # parse dates, pull month/day/year
library(rgbif)       # GBIF access (optional, for later)
library(gbifdb)      # GBIF remote database (optional, for later)
library(sf)          # spatial data (shapefiles, transects)
library(httr2)       # iNaturalist API calls (used by sourced scripts)
```

###### BUILD THE SAN DIEGO REFERENCE TABLE ######
```{r build-reference, message=FALSE}
# This sources your pipeline scripts so the SD bee reference table is
# always built from one source of truth (no rebuilding by hand here).
#
# native_bee_checklist.R makes ~430 iNaturalist API calls (~3-4 min),
# so we only re-run it if the saved checklist CSV doesn't already exist.
# Delete data/outputs/SD_native_bee_checklist.csv if you want to force a refresh.

if (!file.exists("data/outputs/SD_native_bee_checklist.csv")) {
  message("Checklist not found - running native_bee_checklist.R (this calls the API, ~3-4 min)...")
  source("scripts/native_bee_checklist.R")
}

# Build the master reference table (fast, no API calls).
# This creates the `bee_reference` object with key_full, rank, etc.
source("scripts/bee_reference_table.R")
```

###### DATA CLEANING (CABR SPECIMENS) ######
```{r data-cleaning}
getwd()

raw_bee_data <- readxl::read_excel("data/cabr_surveys/lethal/CABR_specimens_V8.xlsx")

clean_bee_data <- raw_bee_data %>%
  mutate(date_clean = mdy(Date),
         month = month(date_clean),
         day   = day(date_clean),
         year  = year(date_clean),
         across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(.x, "")))

# Flag records missing coordinates
# (filter default is TRUE, but best practice to write == TRUE explicitly)
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>%
  mutate(missinglatlong = is.na(Latitude) | is.na(Longitude))
missinglatlong <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missinglatlong == TRUE)

# Flag records missing genus or species
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>%
  mutate(missinggenusspecies = is.na(Genus) | is.na(Species))
missinggenusspecies <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missinggenusspecies == TRUE)

# Flag records missing collection method / plant
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>%
  mutate(missingmethodplant = is.na(Method...Plant))
missingmethodplant <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missingmethodplant == TRUE)

# CABR specimen checklist key (matches the genus_subgenus_species style
# used in the SD reference table so the two can be joined later)
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>%
  mutate(oldscientificname = paste0(Genus, "_", Subgenus, "_", Species))

unique_old_species_list <- unique(clean_bee_data$oldscientificname)

View(unique_old_species_list)
```

###### BEES: DIVERSITY COMPARISON (SD COUNTY / POINT LOMA / CABR) ######
```{r bee-diversity}
# The 6 bee families found in San Diego County (Stenotritidae is
# Australia-only and is not expected here - kept for reference).
bee_family <- c("Andrenidae", "Apidae", "Colletidae",
                "Halictidae", "Megachilidae", "Melittidae")

# San Diego County reference table was built above via source().
# `bee_reference` already has: key_full, key_genus_species,
# key_species_only, rank, and full taxonomy.

# San Diego County taxon richness (all unique genus_subgenus_species)
sd_taxon_richness <- n_distinct(bee_reference$key_full)

cat("San Diego County taxon richness:", sd_taxon_richness, "\n")

# (Point Loma and CABR checklists will be added here once their
#  data is prepared, then compared as a % of SD County diversity.)
```
